about: Image size is PSRAM: .flash.text and .flash.rodata are copied there at boot in 64 kB pages (.ext_ram.dummy), so a page the image grows is 64 kB the UI loses. tools/check_image_budget.py fails a build of the full kit that needs more pages than listed. Raising a number is a decision: do it in the pull request that needs it, with the launcher's free PSRAM measured (crosspad-hil mem).
